decisions.statement: Approve PERSONAL_NAME_DOMAIN and FIRST_PERSON_REFERENT as high-value L01 semantic targets, without yet assigning KALA or AN as canonical standalone forms.

Approve SECOND_PERSON_REFERENT, CONTENT_SELECTOR and QUESTION_OPERATOR as governed semantic/function targets for L01 pedagogy, while preserving that EN/KU/KE token-level historical meanings remain unrecovered.
Approve RESIDENCE_LIVE and PREFERENCE_LIKE as semantic targets needed by OPI 7 and OPI 9, preserving VANI recovered meaning null and VAME current GATE authority until a later mapping gate.
Approve SPEAK_LANGUAGE_USE as the eighth semantic target based on L01 communicative needs and recovered phrase contexts, without assigning ZAMI a standalone historical gloss.

Confirm this gate approves semantics only. Observed forms KALA, AN, EN, KU, KE, VANI, VAME and ZAMI are merely investigation candidates until a separate form-mapping and canonical-governance decision.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create or promote any HNK form.
Does not convert inferred phrase-token roles into historical recovery claims.
Does not change VANI meaning null or VAME GATE.
Does not globalize KU/KE/EN behavior as universal grammar.
